i.x: Admins can now open the Management tab in view-only mode: Companies, User Accounts and Storage & Backup. Adding or changing companies and users, Data Tools, Import Mileage and AI Studio stay Master-only.
Admins get the fleet tools: show or hide Samsara vehicles, the automatic odometer option, merge duplicate drivers, and the Deleted work orders view.
Admins can add and use tax exempt forms and company documents. Deleting them, deleting trucks or all drivers, and cloud file storage stay Master-only.

h: Clearer violation history in MVR / Violations

i.x: The driver's violation history is easier to read: bigger rows with a colored edge, status pills (Pending, Convicted, Dismissed, Inspection no ticket), a highlighted ticket number, and a tag showing which inspection a violation came from.

Mark convicted / Mark dismissed buttons in each ticket's details. Tickets with no court date that are over 30 days old are flagged 'likely paid', and one button marks all of them convicted after you confirm.
New Inspection violations (12 months) count on each driver, so roadside violations are tracked without being counted as state convictions.
Violations from inspections that had no ticket are no longer counted as open citations.

In Edit User Account, Window Access now only lists the tabs that are checked under Visible Tabs, for Admin as well as Standard accounts. Uncheck Accounting and its windows disappear from the list; check it again and they come back (earlier choices are kept).

h: Inspection violations now go to the driver's MVR / Violations

i.x: Driver-related violations on inspections (HOS, driver qualification, state/local traffic laws, drugs/alcohol, CDL) are added to that driver's MVR / Violations record. Vehicle-only ones (brakes, tires, lights) are not.
It runs once automatically for your existing inspections (master account), and again every time an inspection is saved or an FMCSA file is imported. Nothing is added twice.

New records start as Pending, so they do not count toward state points until you mark them convicted. If the inspection has a citation #, it is added as an open citation; otherwise as a closed warning.
MVR / Violations has a new button, From inspections, to run it by hand and see what will be added and which inspection drivers have no match in HR.
Android app: the page now recognises the TMS Android app, uses the phone layout on its screen, and checks for updates and downloads files through it.
On a phone, the reminders bell popup no longer runs off the left edge, and the bell sits in the top bar instead of covering the SAFETY tab.
Edit Inspection on a phone: each violation is now stacked (points and code, description, unit and OOS, DataQs), and the points summary and Citation # sit full width instead of being squeezed.
Phone login: the company logo no longer overlaps the name, and the page scrolls and clears the top buttons.
Toolbars above lists (Trucks, Work Orders and others) wrap onto a second line on a phone instead of being cut off.
View switch next to the version number: tap to cycle Auto, Phone or Desktop. Auto still picks by screen size; your choice is remembered on this device.
Files & Media remembers what it has loaded: opened files stay in memory (up to about 90 MB) and downloaded cloud files are kept on this device between sessions, so opening a file again is instant.

When a Files & Media window opens, its photos and PDFs start loading in the background, so by the time you press the eye they are usually ready. The viewer window now opens immediately and shows Loading… instead of making you wait.

The app now adapts to phone screens automatically (screens up to 760 px wide, or touch screens up to 1024 px). Windows open full screen with a larger close button, the menu scrolls sideways, the ribbon folds away after you pick an item, forms become one column, tables scroll sideways with larger text, and the home page stacks. The desktop layout is unchanged.
You can add it to a phone Home Screen like an app (Share > Add to Home Screen) once the web link is set up.
Every password box in the app (including the sign-in screen of the Windows app) now has an eye button at its right end. Click it to see what you typed, click again to hide it.

h: Photos open full width with zoom

i.x: Photos in the file viewer now open at the full width of the viewer (no more small picture in a narrow window). Scroll to move, use the + / - / Fit buttons or Ctrl + mouse wheel to zoom, and double-click the picture to fit it again.

Files & Media (trucks, trailers, inspections, citations, drivers, work orders) now opens the file list and the viewer side by side across the whole work area, full height, so PDFs and photos fill the screen.

The eye icon in Files & Media could take very long because a missing file triggered repeated full cloud scans. It now opens files that are already loaded instantly, tries the cloud once, and gives up after 12 seconds instead of hanging.

Truck Files & Media showed "File content is unavailable" when the file had not finished loading. The viewer now loads the file first (memory, cloud storage, then a fresh cloud scan) and then opens it, for trucks, trailers, inspections, citations and drivers.

h: Generate A Binder window matches the app

i.x: Generate A Binder now looks like your other windows: blue title bar with a red close button, flat compact rows, classic buttons, dark mode supported.
Esc now closes the Generate A Binder window (or the warning inside it first).

h: Photos open big in the file viewer

i.x: Photos opened from Files & Media were shrunk to about 60% by the window auto-fit, so they looked tiny in a narrow window. The viewer is no longer auto-shrunk: photos fill the viewer to its full height, like truck files and PDFs.

h: File viewer loads files after a restart

i.x: Files & Media viewer showed "File content is unavailable" for files not loaded yet. It now looks for the file in memory, in your records and in the cloud (re-scanning it if the first lookup misses) before opening the viewer.
Opening a file from Files & Media no longer shows "File content is not available" first: it now loads the file through the same path as truck files and shows it in the joined viewer window.

h: File preview uses the same sister window as trucks

i.x: Opening a file from Files & Media (inspections, citations, drivers, work orders) now works exactly like the truck Files & Media: the file list and the viewer sit side by side as joined windows of the same height, with the same zoom and download controls.

h: File preview opens to the right

i.x: Viewing a file from Files & Media (inspections, citations, drivers, work orders, fleet) now opens it in its own Preview window docked to the right of the Files & Media window, not below the list. Click another file to switch it, Close Preview or the X closes it, and it closes with its Files & Media window.

h: FMCSA import: inspections list and possible matches

i.x: Clean inspections from the FMCSA file were kept in a hidden list and never showed in Safety > Inspections. They are now real inspections (No Violation filter) and any left over from an earlier import are moved there on the next import.

If a report number differs but the date, state and driver (or unit/VIN) match one of your inspections, the import shows a Possible matches table: decide later, same inspection (merge) or different (add as new). Nothing is merged unless you choose.

License plates in the Truck # / Trailer fields are replaced with your own truck and trailer numbers, matched by plate or VIN from your Truck list and Trailers (the plate is kept on the record). Includes inspections already in your list.
If original inspections are missing, the import offers to add them back. You can also pick a backup .json file with Import FMCSA data to restore missing inspections.

Attached reports, notes and your own data are never removed or replaced by the import. After every import the app checks that all your earlier inspections are still there and puts back any that are not.

The pencil is gone from the FMCSA CSA / SMS header, so the card keeps its slim look. Master account only: hover any BASIC percentile and a small pencil appears next to it; click it to edit just that score (Enter saves, Esc cancels). It disappears when you move away.

Import FMCSA data reads the official All BASICs Excel (Inspections, Crashes, Violation Summary, Acute-Critical). It shows a preview, matches inspections by state and report number without duplicates, keeps your notes and files, flags conflicts instead of overwriting, and keeps a backup file.

With the full inspection list the guessed clean inspections are gone: measures, divisors and Safety Event Groups use the real dates and levels, and the checks compare them with FMCSA's official numbers.
Crash Indicator is now calculated from the imported crashes (estimated divisor from the official Unsafe Driving measure) and projected, instead of staying fixed.
Time weights now follow FMCSA's boundaries (an inspection exactly 12 months old still counts 2) and calculations run as of the official snapshot date.

h: CSA prediction: estimates with ranges, Import inspections

i.x: Future percentiles are shown as estimates (EST.) with a lighter range bar. Quick estimate uses an FMCSA peer curve when stored, otherwise your own saved months in the same Safety Event Group. Peer-based uses stored FMCSA curves only.
Import inspections: read an FMCSA Excel, CSV or XML list, match by report number without duplicates, keep violation details and DataQs, then recalculate.
Crash Indicator now says Not projected. Amber shows when an estimated range crosses the threshold. Calculation details lists the assumptions behind each prediction.
When the title and dates are hidden, the pencil, prediction, calendar and eye icons move to the right of the percentages in a vertical column, and the card shrinks with a smooth animation.

h: FMCSA card: previous-month groups, spacing, calmer colors

i.x: Safety event groups now show when you look at a previous month (estimated for that month, marked with ~).
A small gap between the measure text and the progress bar.
Calmer, darker green, amber and red for the CSA percentiles, bars and prediction window.

h: FMCSA card: eye menu remembered per user

i.x: The FMCSA card eye menu now hides the safety event groups by default. Hiding Data as of / Updated / Next also hides the FMCSA CSA / SMS title and refresh icon.
Your choices are saved for your own login and come back next time. The Links and buttons option is only shown to the master account.

CSA Score Prediction no longer scales today's percentile. It projects the BASIC measure from your inspections and FMCSA's official measure, recounts the Safety Event Group each month, and shows a percentile only when a peer curve is stored.

Calculation Details window: month-by-month numerator, divisor, measure, group and percentile source, a reconciliation with the official measures, the inspections used, and entry of official measures and peer curves.
New scenario: future inspections clean. Unrecorded inspections are shown as a range instead of one invented number.
The FMCSA CSA card has an eye icon next to the calendar. Choose what to show: dates line, SMS measures, safety event group, bars, counts and links. The BASIC names and percentiles always stay.

CSA Score Prediction has a switch at the bottom: Current inspections only (default; nothing new is added, so scores can creep up as old clean inspections age out) or Keep inspecting at the same pace (new inspections keep arriving at your usual rate with your usual violations per inspection, which shows the steady trend).

Every BASIC on the FMCSA card now shows its Safety Event Group: a compact 1-5 row with your current group in blue, your inspection / crash count, and how many more are needed to reach the next group. Below the minimum it says Insufficient Data. Hover for details. Counts come from your inspections in the last 24 months, plus the FMCSA totals for clean inspections and crashes. The group is separate from the measure and the FMCSA percentile.
Vehicle Maintenance now counts Level 6 inspections too, as in the FMCSA methodology.
The CSA Score Prediction no longer adds any future clean inspections. It only uses the inspections you already have and ages them through the 24-month window.

In Compare CSA Scores the History grid no longer picks up the app-wide row selection (which colored only the percentages and added a 2 selected badge). Hovering now highlights the whole row, including the BASIC name.

In Compare CSA Scores the percentages in every month column now line up exactly (the +/- change sits beside them instead of pushing them over), and the eye icon is the same size as the pencil and print icons.
In CSA Score Prediction the Now column is light gray instead of light green.

Compare CSA Scores: compact cards without the red and green edge lines, a flatter History grid with a BASIC heading and no blue highlight bars, and a pencil icon (master account) next to the eye and print icons to add or edit a month.
CSA Score Prediction: removed the switch to no new inspections link. It always assumes new inspections keep coming at your usual pace with no new violations.

h: CSA windows: dark mode and position fixes

i.x: Dark mode: the CSA Score Prediction and Compare windows, and the FMCSA card, now have dark backgrounds with readable text, colors, bars and tables.
The CSA window icons no longer have a white box behind them.
A CSA window opened on another tab and moved to the top now snaps back below the company header as soon as you return to Home, minimize, or restore it.
On the FMCSA card the threshold line is now drawn on top of the colored bar, thicker and with a thin white edge, so it stays visible even when the score is past the threshold.

h: CSA windows stay below the company header

i.x: The CSA Score Prediction and Compare windows now always stay below the company name and FMCSA card; they cannot be dragged, resized or maximized over them.
Clicking a minimized CSA window in the bottom taskbar while on another tab now opens just that window over the current page instead of jumping to the Home page.

h: FMCSA bars show the full track and threshold

i.x: Each score bar on the FMCSA card now shows its full track so you can see how far it is filled, plus a vertical line at the intervention threshold, like in the prediction window.

h: CSA windows now behave like the other windows

i.x: The CSA Score Prediction and Compare CSA Scores windows now use the same window style as the rest of the app: square corners, the same small minimize / maximize / close buttons, and a purple icon in the title bar.

Minimizing a CSA window now docks it in the bottom taskbar with the other windows, and clicking it there restores it. The CSA windows hide when you switch to another tab and come back when you return to Home. Clicking the icon of an already-open window just brings it forward.

The prediction now counts clean inspections (no violations) in the divisor, like FMCSA does. Before, clean inspections were left out, so a score could rise to 100% even while violation points dropped. By default, new inspections are assumed to keep coming at your usual pace with no new violations, so old violations aging out lowers your score. A link in the window switches to no new inspections.

h: CSA windows stay below the title bar

i.x: The CSA prediction and compare windows can no longer be dragged or opened over the main blue title bar; they always stay below it, including when maximized.

Master account only: the FMCSA percentiles can no longer be changed by clicking them. A pencil icon next to the calendar unlocks editing, a gray floppy-disk Save icon turns on once something is changed, and an X cancels without saving.

The Viewing previous-month notice is now bold yellow text instead of a box. The home header has less empty space, the Now column in the prediction window is light green with bluish bars, and its column headers are one compact line.

The CSA score prediction window has a slim title bar like the other windows and a compact grid, so everything fits without a scroll bar. The inspections used line moved to the bottom row next to How is this worked out and the eye and print buttons.
The small icons are back next to each BASIC name (Unsafe, Crash, HOS, Vehicle, Drugs/Alc., HazMat, Fitness) on the FMCSA card, without adding any height.
The prediction and calendar buttons now sit in a row next to Next (week of), at a normal size. The gray line above the counts is gone and the Viewing previous month bar is slimmer.

In the CSA prediction window the tips (Unsafe Driving, HOS Compliance, etc.) now sit under the grid, just above How is this worked out, and the eye and print buttons use the work order icons without a box.

The FMCSA CSA / SMS scores on the home page are slim again, like the older compact look: small labels, thin underline bars, and the counts on one line. The CSA prediction window is back to its normal size.
The CSA score prediction window is much slimmer: smaller percentages, thinner rows and bars, tighter tip boxes, and a BASIC label at the top of the first column.
Clicking the prediction or calendar button while its window is already open no longer restarts or re-opens it; it stays exactly as it is.
Printing the CSA prediction and comparison from the print preview now matches the preview (table, borders, colors, A4 margins) instead of coming out unstyled.

The FMCSA CSA / SMS title now sits on the same line as Data as of / Updated / Next, so the card is thinner. The card outline is gone and a light gray vertical line separates it from the company logo again.
The CSA score prediction window is smaller and more compact. The prediction and calendar buttons on the FMCSA card are now transparent and stacked one above the other.
Print preview from the prediction or compare window now opens in front instead of behind them.

The FMCSA CSA / SMS box has a new card design with an icon for each score, warning marks, progress bars with the threshold marker, and Data as of / Updated / Next on one line. A round arrow on the left edge slides to the previous month and an arrow on the right slides back to the newer month; the right arrow disappears on the current month.

The CSA Compare and Prediction windows have a new modern look with minimize, maximize and a red close button. Each opens only once: pressing its button again brings the open window forward instead of opening another. Prediction and Compare both have the eye (choose scores) and print buttons, and the printout uses the app print preview. The method explanation in Prediction is hidden until you open it. Adding earlier months is easier: type the month (like 09/2026) and fill all seven scores in one row, or click a month heading to edit it. The Predict button was removed from the calendar menu and has its own button.

The September 2026 CSA / SMS scores (Unsafe 23%, Crash 28%, HOS 90%, Vehicle 70%, Drugs/Alc. 0%, HazMat 0%, Fitness 0%, with the measures and counts) are now saved in the app history. You can open them from the calendar button once the next month is loaded, and they are used in Compare.

New prediction button on the CSA / SMS strip (and in the calendar menu). It works out your points and estimated percentiles for now, next month, in 6 months and in 12 months from the inspections (DVER) you have added, using the glossary rules: severity x time weight, the 30-point cap, +2 out of service, and HOS divided by driver inspections instead of truck count. It also tells you when a score should drop below its threshold.

h: CSA scores: monthly history and compare

i.x: New calendar button on the FMCSA CSA / SMS strip: pick a previous month to see its percentiles (they animate to the new values) and use Back to current month to return. Compare scores opens a draggable window that shows every saved month, says what increased or decreased, and flags thresholds crossed. It has a print button and an eye button to choose which scores to show. Months are saved automatically after each update and everyone sees them.

h: FMCSA sign-in also refreshes the dates and counts

i.x: Closing the Invoices or Disputes window now throws away any dropped or selected files and open Add invoice window, so reopening starts clean.

h: Add invoice window fits many files

i.x: Dropping many invoices (for example 70) no longer makes the Add invoice window taller than the screen: the file name list is compact and scrolls, and the buttons stay visible. All Invoices & Disputes windows now also stay within the screen height and scroll when needed.

h: Ryder invoices: tax charges now read

i.x: Contract & Rental invoices now read the Taxes section of each vehicle page (for example AZ 5% Surcharge, AZ Privilege Tax credit, Total taxes). The amount shows in a new TAX column, the tax lines show in Notes, and the TAX column is in print/Excel. Invoices uploaded earlier need to be uploaded again to pick this up.

h: AI chats: date and time on every message

i.x: Every message in all AI chats (Work Orders, Invoices & Disputes, Maintenance Reports) now shows the date and time it was sent, and the Thinking… bubble shows how many seconds it has been working.

h: AI: clearer connection error and one retry

i.x: When the AI cannot be reached, the app now retries once automatically and, if it still fails, says that it could not reach the AI service (instead of just Failed to fetch).

Invoices: whenever the PCS odometer is higher than the invoice ending odometer, the note now reads exactly "PCS odometer is higher than invoice ending odometer" (in the table and the line window). The "Minimum mileage?" note is removed everywhere.

Invoices: a PCS odometer lower than the invoice ending odometer now sets the status to Issue automatically. A PCS odometer higher than the invoice ending odometer no longer triggers Review, so those lines are OK automatically. A status you set yourself (for example Review) is kept.

h: Invoice notes: black text, red and green flags

i.x: Invoices NOTES column: all notes are now black. When the PCS odometer is lower than the invoice ending odometer it says "PCS odometer is lower than the invoice ending odometer" in dark red. Credit lines say "This is a credit invoice" in dark green, or "Credit invoice total is not negative" in dark red if the total is not negative.
Add invoice window: the File name box is now the same width and alignment as Invoice from and Invoice type, with .pdf inside the box.

Invoices: dropping a PDF now opens the Add invoice window straight away (no separate Save file as box). It has a File name box, Invoice from = Auto-detect and Invoice type = Auto-detect. The green check adds it (with the new name); the red X cancels and adds nothing.

h: Invoices: status pop-up closes on second click

i.x: Invoices: clicking the Status pill of a selected row again now closes the pop-up (it used to close and reopen). Selected rows stay highlighted.
User Management > User accounts: the list now scrolls, so every user can be reached.

h: Invoices: your note shows in Notes

i.x: Invoices: when you write your own note in an invoice line (for example All good), the NOTES column now shows your note instead of the automatic message.
The NOTES column is narrower and sizes itself to the longest note instead of stretching.

h: Invoices: selection stays when picking a status

i.x: Invoices (and Disputes outcome): when several rows are drag-selected and you click the Status (or Outcome) pill, the rows now stay highlighted while the dropdown is open and after you choose.

h: User editor: window access follows the tabs

i.x: Edit User Account: the Window access list now shows only the groups for the tabs that are checked (turn Accounting off and the Accounting windows disappear from the list; Admin shows all). The old Imaging group is removed.

h: Invoice total auto-calc and typed inactivation date

i.x: Invoice line window: Total now calculates itself from Amount + Tax (and the other charge fields) as you type. You can still type over the Total manually; editing Amount or Tax again recalculates it.
Inactivate truck/trailer: the date is a plain typed box already filled with today (MM/DD/YYYY, slashes added automatically) instead of the calendar picker.
Print preview no longer jumps between zoom values (82% / 84%) or turns blurry on long reports. The zoom now settles once and stays; Fit works as before.

h: Print preview looks like the paper page

i.x: Print preview now shows the report on a real page with proper margins (like the print window), instead of edge to edge and zoomed in. Applies to the toll report, other report prints and form prints; scroll, zoom and select still work, and Print… prints it the same way.

h: Toll: copy picture style, clean IDs, print

i.x: Toll Reports (AAA Lease): the navy header with red total now appears only on Copy picture. Print and the print preview use the plain classic look.
Transponder ID no longer shows plate entries such as IN-3223823 or FL-DF22LW, only the transponder numbers.
The real Print… now prints exactly what the preview shows (it was printing the old generic Toll Reports table with TRUCK / FEES columns).

h: Print: no app window in the printout

i.x: The Print… button in the preview now prints only the report itself (it used to send the whole app window, including the blue title bar, to the printer). Applies to every print preview in the app.

h: Toll reports: AAA Lease, preview, Excel

i.x: Toll Reports: removed This month; added an AAA Lease button that shows only Dilmurod Aka and Shorustam trucks. In that mode Copy table, Copy picture and Print use your October layout (Unit Number, Transponder ID, VIN Number, Plate, Total Billed Amount, red total).
Print now opens the in-app preview (zoom, select) with an Excel button that downloads a Summary + Detailed Breakdown workbook like your October file, without the green number-as-text flags.
The same preview now opens for all other print buttons in the app that used to jump straight to the system dialog.

DILMUROD AKA (units 590184, 585615, 588187, 585512, 587198, 643291) and SHORUSTAM (unit 555742) are now remembered as responsible parties. They appear in the Resp. Party list, and a new work order for one of those units picks the owner automatically (you can still change it). Totals by Resp. party in Maintenance Reports, the bottom bar and the print/copy show them in capitals with their own line, only when money was spent. Truck owners (Ryder/Penske) are unchanged.

Print preview (all reports and forms): text can now be selected and copied, and there are − / + / Fit buttons plus Ctrl + mouse wheel (and Ctrl +/−/0) to zoom from 30% to 400% and scroll around the page. The Print… button still opens the system print dialog.

Totals by Resp. party (bottom bar of Maintenance Reports): all drivers now show as one DRIVER total with the work order count, instead of each driver's name. Company, Ryder, Penske and the others stay as they were.

Print and Copy picture: the Totals by Responsible party table now lists all drivers together on one DRIVER line (total and work order count) instead of one line per driver, and TBA is left out. On screen the totals still show each driver's name.

h: Driver name in the Resp. party column

i.x: Maintenance Reports table: when the responsible party is Driver, the Resp. party column now shows the driver's name (for example WILDOR LOUIS) instead of the word DRIVER.

h: Driver names in the maintenance report

i.x: Maintenance Reports table: the Driver column now reads both names from the work order description (for example DATEMIEA ALLEN / SHAWN BERRY) instead of a short leftover like DAT.

Totals by Resp. party (screen, copy picture and the generated report) now list the driver names instead of the word Driver. Two drivers show together on one line, and a driver half of a split counts under that driver. The separate split section is gone.
TBA is hidden from the printed totals, the picture and the generated report, but still counted in your data.
Resp. party is shown in capital letters in the list and in the report.

h: Refresh button on Invoice and Toll reports

i.x: Invoice Reports and Toll Reports now have a green Refresh button right before the printer, the same as the Maintenance Report.

h: Work order header uses less space

i.x: Work order header: Resp. Party now sits right under Odometer and the Driver box right under Driver Type, so the two share one row and the form is one row shorter.

h: Driver picked automatically from the description

i.x: Resp. Party now fills itself from the description: write Driver: NAME and it picks Driver; write two drivers (Driver: IZZY LEE / WADE WALKER) and it picks a 50/50 split with both names. You can still change it by hand, and once you do it stops auto-filling.
Custom Split: Driver and Driver - choose a name are now one option called Driver, with a box to type or pick the name. When you open it, the names from the description are already filled in.

h: Splits no longer saved in the list

i.x: Resp. Party list: a 50/50 or custom split you set on one work order no longer shows up as an option on new work orders. Only your own custom parties (like a warranty company) are kept in the list. A work order that has a split still shows it.

h: Quick add driver to HR from the split

i.x: Custom Split: if the driver name you type is not in HR, an Add to HR button appears. It opens a small window (first name, last name, role); the driver is created and filled into the split right away.

h: Readable split names in the report table

i.x: Maintenance Reports table: the Resp. party column now shows split work orders as IZZY LEE / WADE WALKER instead of the long 50/50: Driver (...) + Driver (...) text. Percent and amount splits show the split after the names.

h: Work order driver split: type a name

i.x: Custom Split: after choosing Driver, you can now type the driver's name or pick one from the list (it suggests as you type).
The Driver — choose a name option now sits right below Driver in the party list.
Maintenance Report: a split between two drivers now shows both full names, for example IZZY LEE / WADE WALKER, with what each one pays.

h: Smooth list scrolling, equal Home boxes

i.x: Moving down or up a list with the arrow keys now scrolls smoothly. The grid no longer jumps back and forth or stutters when the selection reaches the bottom or top.
Home page: Company Details and Contact Information now share the height equally with Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms, so nothing is squished.
When you move the selection with the Up and Down keys, the list now scrolls along so the selected row is always in view, in every list of the app.
New Jersey ST-4: the exempt purpose box is filled in with the trucking exemption text (N.J.S.A. 54:32B-8.43) and the statute number line is filled with 8.43. Neither has an edit box.

The fill-in window for tax exempt forms now shows only the boxes you actually change: vendor / shop name, date and the seller address. Company details (EIN, address, name, title and so on) stay filled in automatically and no longer get a box.

New Jersey ST-4: the EIN goes in the Eligible Nonregistered Purchaser box, the New Jersey registration number is left empty, and the seller name and address lines are no longer filled with Westmore's address.

In any list (truck services, work orders, drivers, citations, inspections, tax forms and more) the Up and Down arrows move the selected row, Home and End jump to the first and last, and Enter opens the selected row like a double-click.
Escape closes the active window (it still asks first if there are unsaved changes).
Ctrl+A on a tax exempt form no longer paints the whole form dark blue, and Escape clears any highlight.

h: Tax forms open in a movable window

i.x: Tax exempt forms and the Generate screen now open as normal app windows: drag them, minimize them, resize them, with the same colors as the rest of the app.
The delete confirmation for a tax exempt form now appears in front of the form instead of behind it.

Tax exempt forms with fillable fields now match every field by name: company, address, city, state, ZIP, EIN, USDOT, MC, phone, email, IRP, IFTA, dates, signer name and title. Fields the app does not recognise get their own box in Generate, and Claude looks for them in your whole app and remembers the answer.
The Westmore IRP account number (456957) is now filled automatically on tax exempt forms that ask for it, and it is used if there is no IRP document in Company Documents.

h: Fillable forms: IRP, IFTA and vehicles

i.x: Generate on fillable forms (like Utah TC-719) now shows Purchase / lease date (today), IRP and IFTA account numbers, dealer number, seller address, and a Vehicles section: choose a truck or trailer and its VIN, year, make and model fill in (up to the number of rows on the form).
IFTA and IRP numbers are read from your Company Documents. Anything else still empty is looked up in your whole app by Claude, and remembered for next time. Redeploy worker.js.

Truck and Trailer Services: drop one PDF that holds several cab cards or DOT inspections. It is split page by page into one file per unit, each matched to its truck or trailer and read for dates. Scanned PDFs can be split by Claude AI (it asks first). Redeploy worker.js for the AI split.

A Rename button (pencil) on every uploaded file in Files & Media for trucks, trailers, work orders, citations, inspections, drivers, and a pencil on the company document file box. The file type (.pdf) is kept.
Truck and trailer windows now warn "Unsaved Changes" if you changed a date or any field and close with the X without saving.
Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms: dragging to select now covers only the rows between where you started and where the mouse is. Moving back up or down unselects the rows you moved away from.
Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms: after selecting several rows, clicking a row that is not selected now unselects the old ones and selects only that row.
Company Documents: opening a document and closing it without typing no longer asks about unsaved changes.

h: Click a selected row to clear all

i.x: Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms: clicking a selected row now unselects the whole selection instead of only that one row. Dragging over selected rows still unselects just those.
A blue "N selected" tag appears after the search box when rows are selected, with a small x to clear.
The delete button only appears on a selected row. Rows light up with a blue edge when you hover.
The Generate button was removed from the tax exempt form rows. Double-click a form to open it and press Generate there.
Selecting in one box clears the selection in the other.
Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms: one click selects a row in blue (click again to unselect) and drag over rows to select several. Double-click opens it.
Edit document: once a file is attached the Cloud AI upload box is hidden, and the remove (X) button is red.
What's new shows the Before and After pictures again for the last updates (1.0.536 to 1.0.541), which had been left out.
A tax exempt form uploaded on another computer now opens for coworkers right away instead of saying the file is not available. The app fetches it from the cloud when needed.
The Fill empty lines with AI button was removed from the tax form window.
Seller address: paste it with or without commas, in capitals or lower case. It is read the same way and written in one format: STREET, CITY, ST ZIP.
The owner's CDL number and state (NY) are filled automatically on the forms that ask for a driver license, without AI.
Driver license number and state of issue are now separate lines placed where the form asks for them, and are filled automatically from the driver license in Company Documents (no AI needed).
Tax ID number and its state of issue are filled on Minnesota and North Carolina.

h: Tax forms: AI fills from your app

i.x: Generate: a purple Fill empty lines with AI button reads your company details and company documents (for example the owner's driver license) and fills lines that are still empty. You can edit everything.
South Carolina now has the seller address split into street, city, state and ZIP.
Checkboxes are ticked on Pennsylvania, Nebraska, Missouri, Minnesota, Michigan and Indiana for interstate trucking, plus the Nebraska category and Minnesota number.
South Carolina retail license line now reads 85-2491725 FL (EIN, then the state abbreviation).

h: EIN with state on license lines

i.x: South Carolina: the retail license line now fills your EIN and the state, e.g. 85-2491725 (FL). The Ohio vendor license line is filled too.

h: Older tax forms get the new fields

i.x: Tax forms you added earlier now also show EIN, phone, address and the other fields in Generate, without deleting and re-adding them.
Generate: type the seller address once and it is split into street, city, state and ZIP on the form.
Company phone, EIN and the new email are now filled on the forms that ask for them and your EIN is used for every state tax or license number line.
Shop name and date are now written at the left of the line with a small gap, in the same font as the pre-filled text.
Generate also shows the other empty lines (seller address, license number with your EIN) so you can edit them.
The form window uses the app blue and a small white download icon.
Tax Exempt Forms: double-click a form to open it, with Download, Generate and Delete buttons.
The 18 pre-filled forms (company, EIN, signature) only ask for the shop name; today's date is added where the form has a date line.
Drag a file onto the Company Documents box: the box splits into Regular upload and Cloud AI upload. Drop on either and the New Document window opens with the file attached, or read by Claude.
New document window: dropping a file only works on the Regular upload and Cloud AI upload boxes, and the whole window no longer turns blue.
Tax Exempt Forms: dragging PDFs onto the box (or the chooser) now works instead of showing a blocked cursor.

h: Cloud AI upload for documents and forms

i.x: New company document: choose Regular upload or Cloud AI upload. Claude reads the document and fills in the name, number and dates.
Tax Exempt Forms: the + button (or dragging files onto the box) offers Regular upload or Cloud AI upload, where Claude finds the state and the blanks to fill.
Company Documents and Tax Exempt Forms now each have a search box before the + button. Tax exempt forms are listed A to Z by state.

Home now has four boxes. The new Tax Exempt Forms box holds one form per state: press Generate, type the shop name, and download the filled PDF. Your company details and today's date are filled in for you.
Drag state tax exempt PDFs onto the box (or press +) to add them. The state is found from the file and the blanks are mapped automatically.
Company Documents is shorter and scrolls, matching the Company Details box.
What's new now shows Before and After pictures for the last two updates (deleted-vendor fix and drag-select).
Edit invoices: drag the mouse over rows to select (or unselect) many at once, and a record count shows under the search.
The invoice list now shows how many invoices there are next to "All invoices".
Invoices: after deleting the last invoice of a vendor, the window now goes back to Ryder instead of saying "Add your first" for a vendor that is no longer in the list.
What's new can now show a Before and After picture for a change, so you can see exactly what is different.
Edit invoices: a vendor dropdown before the search box lets you filter the list by Ryder, Penske or any other vendor.
Invoices: the invoice dropdown now has a search box, and a new edit icon opens a list where you can tick several invoices and delete them at once.
Invoices read by Claude now keep only the digits of the truck unit number (T555742 becomes 555742).

Invoices: choose "Auto-detect vendor" or "Other / custom vendor" and Claude reads invoices from any company, creating the grid, vendor, invoice number and category. Several files can be uploaded at once.
The Add invoice window can be dragged by its title.
The What's new window shows the latest 3 versions; older ones are hidden behind a "Show earlier versions" button.
New "What's new / Version info" entry in the update (download icon) menu, with screenshots of the changes. Click a picture to enlarge it.
The "What's new in this update" link on the update card now opens reliably.
Check for updates now asks GitHub directly, so a build you just published is found immediately instead of after a restart. The app also checks quietly every minute.
The What's new window now has a simpler, flatter look that matches the rest of the app.
A "What's new" window now appears after every update, listing what was added, improved, fixed or removed.
The update card has a "What's new" link, so you can read the changes before you restart. Click the version number at the top any time to see the history.
Outcomes are colour-coded: In Process light green, Credited green, Denied red, Partial Credit orange, Pending yellow.
Clicking the Outcome again now closes its drop-down.
The dispute window has a clean white look with three compact columns and a much bigger Charge description box.
Click an Outcome in the Disputes list to pick a new one. No double-click, and it works on several selected rows at once.
The download button in the file viewer no longer covers the PDF viewer's own buttons.

h: Drops go to the front window only

i.x: Dragging files only works on the window you are focused on, not the windows behind it.
Cleaner download icon in the top bar, spaced like the others.
Drag a file over a work order and choose: Regular upload, Scan invoice (free) or Scan with Claude AI.
The free scan runs first; Claude is only used if you agree.
Truck and trailer document uploads start as soon as you press Upload, with a progress card.
The upload result is a tidy list of truck and file name.
"Parts" is now a service you can add on a work order. The service list is in alphabetical order.
Parts Inventory was removed from the Fleet tab.
Drop an invoice on a work order: it is renamed, the services and prices are filled in, and you confirm everything before it is applied.
Scanned registration and DOT files can be read, and you can type a truck number as well as choosing it.
Files that were already uploaded show an "Already uploaded" warning.
Drop registration and DOT documents onto Truck or Trailer Services. The app reads the unit and dates, and updates the schedule.
Invoice Reports and Toll Reports windows in the Fleet tab, with copy table, copy picture and print.
